description: Download the files attached to one already-fetched mail and file them as documents. Required: email_id. Optional: entity + entity_id to say what they belong to (a mail already matched to an asbestos job attaches to that job by itself), include_inline (default false — signature images and template logos stay out), max_bytes. Running it twice does not store anything twice. Returns what was stored, what was skipped and why. The mailbox is only read: nothing is marked as seen and nothing is deleted.

entity.description: Record type the attachments belong to (use with entity_id)

max_bytes.description: Maximum size in bytes for attachments to store

name: fetch_attachments
